target.label: A settings screen you can navigate, trust, and verify

rationale: P0 coverage is 100% and overall coverage is 91% (minimum 80%), but P1 coverage is 86% against a 90% target. Both shortfalls are in Story 5.1 (5.1-AC4 deep link, 5.1-AC6 keyboard operation and focus ring), verified by asserting strings in JS/CSS source rather than by exercising behaviour. Unlike the 2026-08-27 trace, this decision carries no evidence caveat: the integration suite is now deterministic (two consecutive full runs, 233/233 identical) and runs in CI. The remaining shortfall is a written, closed decision recorded in deferred-work.md, which names CONCERNS as the accepted cost.

uncovered_requirements.gap: #tab-{slug} deep link asserted as a source substring in the enqueued JS; the link is never followed
Keyboard operation ('ArrowRight') and focus ring ('.skw-tab:focus-visible') asserted as strings in JS/CSS source; no key is pressed. ARIA wiring and roving tabindex ARE verified against real markup.
